title: Size of the move (1/4): simplify what PR #2351 left around the cut rule
description:
## As asked

Piece 1 of 4 of LIN-4346 ("Deciding the size of the move becomes part of the run"). It lands first: pieces 2–4 raise prompt-size ceilings and touch the cut rule's neighbours, so they should land on the simpler shape this leaves.

**Why.** PR #2351 (LIN-4345) was read blind twice as mixed (passes BS and BT on LIN-4150). Its leftovers sit in the code the rest of LIN-4346 reworks. The biggest is the prompt-size budget test turning into a second change log. LIN-4346's Done-when includes "the code around the cut rule is simpler than PR #2351 left it".

**This piece's slice of the approved plan**

* `tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js`: each ceiling carries its number, the latest ticket, and one short reason. Drop the "Earlier:" chains (e.g. on `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES`, back to LIN-3378). Before deleting any "Earlier" clause, check that `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md` holds that fact; move it there if not. LIN-3633's "every ceiling names a ticket" tests stay unchanged.
* `tests/unit/stage-intent-cut.test.js`:
  * The source scan for a literal copy of CUT can never fire (the LIN-4362 marker census forces any copy to interpolate `AS_ASKED_HEADING`; BT planted a census-compliant copy and it passed). Replace it with a check that can fail, or delete it and rely on the rendered "exactly once / never" test. Say which, and why.
  * Find deciding stages from `STAGE_INTENT` by identity with the DECIDE line, not a regex on DECIDE's wording.
  * Stop pinning whole sentences.
* The idea of a cut is restated outside `CUT` (`lib/prompts/stage-intent.js`): scoping's Out-of-Scope bullet, plan's opening clause, and two completion signals. State the rule once, in `CUT`; a template may only say where its cuts are written. (Piece 3 deletes scoping's bullet anyway; trimming it here is fine.)
* Fix the stale first LIN-4345 row in `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md` that still says "PR pending (branch `feat/lin-4345-upstream-cut-rule`)".
* **Not here:** folding CUT's route into ASK. Rewording the rule would void LIN-4345's measured 3/3; LIN-4350 owns it.

**Testing strategy / witness**

* Rendered prompt bytes for all kinds are unchanged, except where removing a duplicated cut explanation changes them on purpose; if so, say which kinds and record it beside the ceiling.
* Budget and cut tests pass and can still fail: a planted rendered copy of CUT fails the cut test, and a ceiling with no ticket fails the budget test (show both mutations in the PR).
* The budget file is smaller than at `11dc1d7bd`.

**Session fit:** fits one session.

**Plan-review due:** no — covered by LIN-4346's approving plan-review (comment d71c7085-b2ad-4760-8070-53bc917f9a1f, rev 1).

**Grounding commit:** `11dc1d7bd` (`origin/main` when the plan was written and reviewed; still `origin/main` at breakdown, 7 Nov 22:45 UTC).

**Starting point:** LIN-4346's approved plan is this piece's starting point. Read it in full in LIN-4346's description under `## Implementation Plan` (revision 1), with the builder notes in the approving verdict (comment d71c7085, 22:42). Read LIN-4346's `## As asked` block for the person's words and John's comment of 22:18 for the size ruling (err larger). Follow the plan; where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so on LIN-4346.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Outcome

Implemented in PR [#2354](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2354>), squash-merged as `9c2a378a` and deployed (Harbour footer `9c2a378a`). The work follows LIN-4346's approved plan, piece 1, with no deviations. Review accepted dropping "inherited too" from plan's clause because `CUT` already covers it. Close-out added `4d59883b`, which restores the scoping regression guards and widens `RULE_WORDS`, as review asked.

**Not run after the deploy:** the behavioural check that a plan run lists a cut inherited from scoping and raises its `DECISION:` ruling. No such run has happened yet. If it fails, the rollback is to revert `9c2a378a`. The details are in the close-out comment.

The full history is kept in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

comments.body:
## Implementation: PR open, CI green

**PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2354 (head `3b69d52f`). `ci-success` passed: unit tests, all four E2E shards and the secret scan.

**What landed** (the plan's piece 1; `origin/main` was still `11dc1d7bd`, so nothing had drifted):
- **Budget file:** 50,359 → 21,375 bytes. Each ceiling now says its number, the latest ticket and one short reason. Every "Earlier:" clause and the header's history paragraphs moved to a new `## Ceiling history` section in `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md`. I checked each one first: the rows there record what changed but not byte counts, so all of them moved. LIN-3633's tests are unchanged.
- **Cut test:**
  - Deciding stages are found by identity (`STAGE_INTENT[k][0] === DECIDE`).
  - The rendered test counts `CUT` itself.
  - No whole sentences are pinned; the only pin left is the order of the `DECISION:` and `BLOCKED:` tokens, which code reads.
  - **I replaced the literal scan rather than deleting it.** The new scan looks for the longest stretch of `CUT` with no interpolation in it, across every file under `lib/`. It catches BT's census-compliant copy, which the old test missed (7/7 at `11dc1d7bd`). It also reaches copies outside `generatePrompt` (the preamble, kickoffs, completion signals), which the rendered test cannot see.
  - `CUT` and `DECIDE` are now exported. That adds 14 source bytes; the reason is beside the ceiling.
- **The rule is stated once, in `CUT`.** Scoping's Out of Scope bullet, plan's opening and the two completion signals now say only where cuts go. Rendered bytes changed on purpose for plan (−39) and scoping (−25); every other kind and the routing prompt are byte-identical. Both are recorded beside their ceilings.
- **Change log:** the stale first LIN-4345 row now names PR #2351, and a LIN-4367 row is added.

**Witness:** eight mutations, listed in the PR. Some of them:
- A planted rendered copy of `CUT` fails the cut test.
- A ceiling with no ticket fails LIN-3633's test.
- Restoring any of the old restatements fails the new restatement guard.
- Rewording DECIDE's licence now leaves the cut test green; the old test failed it.

**Local runs:** `npm run test:unit` gives 24160/24160 on the branch and 24159/24159 on base.

**For review:** "inherited too" is dropped from plan's clause. I read `CUT` ("not delivered in full, by scope…") as already covering a cut scoping made.

**Cuts to the As-asked block:** none.

## Review — LIN-4367

Reviewed PR [#2354](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2354), head `3b69d52fd853b532ae39caeb82aa3cd8544bf48f`, against base `11dc1d7bd`. Nothing has landed on `origin/main` since the ticket was filed, so the grounding still holds.

CI: green on `3b69d52f`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success all pass. I also ran the cut and budget tests locally on the head (24/24).

### Against what was asked, sentence by sentence
- **Budget file: each ceiling has its number, latest ticket and one short reason; "Earlier:" chains dropped.** Met. There are 0 "Earlier" clauses now, down from 50 at `11dc1d7bd`. `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` now names only LIN-4367. Two LIN-4085 onboarding comments still read "new at X, raised to Y (+N)". That's mild, but they name one ticket, so I'm not counting it as a finding.
- **Check the change log holds each fact before deleting it; move it if not.** Met. A new `## Ceiling history` section has every chain, oldest first. Spot-check of ticket mentions (old test vs. log): LIN-3378 5→5, LIN-3292 1→5, LIN-4021 11→13. LIN-3300 13→10 and LIN-3669 3→2 are lower because the latest reason stays beside the ceiling in the test.
- **LIN-3633 "every ceiling names a ticket" tests unchanged.** Met. The diff doesn't touch them, and mutation M2 below shows they still fail.
- **The literal scan can never fire: replace it or delete it, and say which.** Met: replaced, with the reason given. It now scans every `lib/**/*.js` for CUT's longest stretch with no interpolation (>100 chars). M3 confirms it catches a census-compliant copy, which is BT's case.
- **Find deciding stages by identity with DECIDE, not a regex.** Met (`STAGE_INTENT[k][0] === DECIDE`). M4 shows rewording DECIDE's licence no longer gives a false failure.
- **Stop pinning whole sentences.** Met. The only pin left is the order of the `DECISION:`/`BLOCKED:` tokens, which code reads (M8 fails correctly). See finding 1: this step also removed two LIN-4345 guards that weren't sentence pins.
- **State the rule once, in CUT; a template only says where its cuts go** (scoping bullet, plan opening, two completion signals). Met in all four places. On the open question: I agree with dropping "inherited too". When a plan doesn't deliver a sentence because scoping cut it, the plan isn't delivering that sentence either. That is "not delivered in full, by scope", so CUT already covers it and no ruling is needed. A new restatement guard keeps the old wording from coming back (M5). It's narrower than it looks, though: see finding 2.
- **Fix the stale first LIN-4345 change-log row.** Met. "PR pending" is gone, row 477 now names PR #2351 (`11dc1d7bd`), and a LIN-4367 row has been added.
- **Not here: folding CUT's route into ASK.** Respected. `CUT`'s text is unchanged; only `export` was added.
- **Witness: rendered bytes unchanged except deliberate removals, recorded beside the ceiling.** Met. plan −39 and scoping −25 are recorded beside their ceilings, along with stage-intent source +14 (exports) and template-defs −64. The total is now 345202, down 114.
- **Witness: a planted rendered CUT copy fails the cut test, and a ceiling with no ticket fails the budget test.** Met. I re-ran both myself (M1, M2).
- **Witness: the budget file is smaller than at `11dc1d7bd`.** Met: 50,359 → 21,375 bytes.

### Mutations I ran (each reverted afterwards)
| # | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | Rendered `CUT` added to the review template | Red: "every deciding stage renders the cut rule exactly once…" (plus budget) |
| M2 | Ticket removed from the `look-into` ceiling comment | Red: LIN-3633 "every ceiling line names a ticket" |
| M3 | Census-compliant copy (`'…' + AS_ASKED_HEADING + '…'`) appended to `lib/proxy-preamble.js` | Red: "no other lib/ source spells out a copy" |
| M4 | DECIDE's licence reworded | Green, as intended |
| M5 | Plan's old "inherited too, quoted with its ruling" clause restored | Red: restatement guard (plus budget) |
| M6 | Scoping bullet paraphrase: "any cuts to the ask, which are not yours and stay unagreed until answered" | **Green in the cut test.** Only the byte budget fails, because the text grew |
| M8 | `DECISION:`/`BLOCKED:` order swapped | Red: closing-contract test |
| M9 | "what is in and out of scope is yours to decide" re-added to scoping | **Only the byte budget fails.** No test fails on the meaning |

### Findings (for close-out to fix, both in `tests/unit/stage-intent-cut.test.js`)
1. **Two LIN-4345 regression guards were removed with nothing replacing them** (inside: the cut-test class this ticket bounds). The old test `scoping no longer owns what is in and out of scope…` checked that scoping's prompt no longer says "in and out of scope is yours to decide" or "flag for the human only product or intent questions", and still says "Read the code first.". These were short fragments, not whole-sentence pins of the rule, and nothing in `tests/unit` checks them now (M9). **Fix:** in the `a template says only where its cuts go` describe, add a test that renders `scoping` and asserts `doesNotMatch(/in and out of scope is yours to decide/)`, `doesNotMatch(/flag for the human only product or intent questions/)` and `match(/Read the code first\./)`. The current head passes all three, which I checked against the source.
2. **The restatement guard only looks for the words "quot" and "ruling"** (inside: the "state the rule once" class). M6 shows a paraphrase that restates the rule passes. **Fix:** at line 83, change `const RULE_WORDS = /\bquot|\bruling/i;` to `const RULE_WORDS = /\bquot|\bruling|not yours|\bagreed\b|DECISION:/i;`. I tried this: it's green on the head (8/8) and red on M6.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Deciding stages still record each cut and raise it as one `DECISION:` ruling once the template restatements are gone. In particular, plan still carries a cut scoping made, now that "inherited too" is dropped.** Inside: this ticket's own change ("state the rule once") depends on it. CI shows the rule text renders once. It does not show how the model behaves. Settle **after the deploy**: on the first plan run for a ticket whose scoping recorded a cut under Out of Scope, the plan's comment must list that cut, and `GET /api/proxy/rulings?issueIdentifier=<ticket>` must show a `DECISION:` ruling for it. If the cut is missing or no ruling was raised, that's the failure. Rollback, which works because the change is only prompt text and tests: revert #2354's squash commit on `main`.
- **Findings 1 and 2 above.** Inside. Settle **before the merge**: close-out makes the two test edits. Then re-run `node --test tests/unit/stage-intent-cut.test.js tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js` and expect it to pass, and confirm M6 now fails the cut test.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

## Close-out — LIN-4367

**Merged:** PR [#2354](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2354), squash `9c2a378a`. The merge was pinned with `--match-head-commit` to head `4d59883b`.

**How it meets the ask:** see the review of 23:09. Every sentence of the As-asked slice was met, the witnesses were re-run as M1–M8, and the verdict was Approve, conditional on two test fixes.

### Changes made in close-out
- **`4d59883b`** (`tests/unit/stage-intent-cut.test.js`) does two things:
  - **Review finding 1:** a new test under `a template says only where its cuts go`. It renders `scoping` and checks two absences and one presence: no "in and out of scope is yours to decide", no "flag for the human only product or intent questions", and "Read the code first." is still there.
  - **Review finding 2:** `RULE_WORDS` changed from `/\bquot|\bruling/i` to `/\bquot|\bruling|not yours|\bagreed\b|DECISION:/i`.

### Ledger
- **Findings 1 and 2 (inside, before the merge): settled by the fix above.** `node --test tests/unit/stage-intent-cut.test.js tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js` gave 25/25 on `4d59883b`. I then ran three mutations against the cut test, reverting each:
  - **M6**, review's paraphrase "any cuts to the ask, which are not yours and stay unagreed until answered", now fails "no deciding stage restates the rule outside its scope line". It passed before the fix.
  - **M9**, "what is in and out of scope is yours to decide" added back to scoping, fails the restored test.
  - **M10**, "Read the code first." removed, fails the restored test.
  - Full local unit run on the branch: 24161/24161.
- **Plan carries a cut scoping made and raises its `DECISION:` ruling (inside, after the deploy): NOT RUN.** The deploy has landed: the Harbour footer shows `9c2a378a`. The live `/templates` page shows the new wording, with none of the old "quoted with its ruling" or "inherited too" wording, and `CUT` renders 8 times for the 8 deciding stages. That is a rendered-text check only, and review said it does not prove behaviour.
  - **Why it wasn't run:** the check needs the first plan run for a ticket whose scoping recorded a cut under Out of Scope, and none has happened since the deploy. Starting one on another ticket just to test this isn't mine to do.
  - **Who can run it:** the operator, at the next such plan run. The plan comment must list the cut, and `GET /api/proxy/rulings?issueIdentifier=<ticket>` must show a `DECISION:` ruling for it.
  - **If it fails:** review named the rollback. Revert squash `9c2a378a` on `main`. Review named no monitor.
  - This is also recorded on the PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2354#issuecomment-6714462626

### Final CI
Green on `4d59883b`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success all passed (run 42424116375).

### Housekeeping
- **Status:** Done.
- **Description:** I confirmed the archive first: snapshot `18d09c4b` at 23:28:31Z matches the pre-prune description exactly. There were no stage artifacts below the As-asked block to prune, so I added only an outcome stub.
- **Related tickets:** LIN-4368 (2/4), which this ticket blocked, is now unblocked; I left a note there. The parent LIN-4346 stays In Progress for pieces 2–4.
- **Outside follow-ups:** none. The ledger had no outside items.
